description: welib is Emmanuel Branlard and contributors' Python and Matlab library for wind-energy engineering calculations. It combines airfoil processing, steady and unsteady blade-element momentum methods, beam and finite-element analyses, hydrodynamic wave loads, controls and signal-processing utilities. Inputs are aerodynamic curves, geometry, structural properties and loading conditions; outputs include rotor performance, deflections, modes, wave loads and fatigue-related quantities. It is not tied to one site or period; numerical resolution follows the chosen example and model. Source is free under MIT, with installation instructions and an extensive linked example gallery. A limitation is that these are separate engineering tools with different assumptions, requiring application-specific verification, not one fully coupled validated turbine model. welib can help construct or check wind-infrastructure simulations. Kynema-UGF (model-kynema-ugf) offers related wind-flow modelling. The README also identifies its OpenFAST tooling lineage. No example datasets or model archives were downloaded.
